results.why: An MSL keep-out over the declared ground's ridge (experiments/policies/msl_dem_zone.yaml: msl-ridge-nfz, a polygon_fence with altitude_ref MSL, 606-700 m MSL, 60-140 m east of home and 30 m either side of the home's meridian; agl-band 8-60 m above the ground; the DEM experiments/worlds/dem_cmac_wgs84.json, crest 602.75 m MSL at 100 m east). A goto pilot flies at 3 m/s from 15 m above the start's ground at x = -45 to a pad 200 m east. target_x -45 flies straight east, 13 m beside the zone's margin ring, crossing the ridge over the AGL floor. target_x -20 flies a diagonal whose straight line cuts the ring's south-west corner over the crest (2.5 m into the footprint at 140 m east), where the AGL floor needs at least 610.75 m MSL, inside the zone's band: no height there is legal, so the Shield must take the aircraft round the corner. The gates are the requirement: no P0 escape, no breach, no polygon entry, the target reached, the flight ended safe. Read as AGL the same zone would sit 606 m above the ground and never bind; this family exists to fly an MSL polygon_fence over a varying ground on the sitl / hil rails (the harness names the ground to the nodes, rail_node_args). Not swept: a lane into the footprint's middle (x = 0). Measured headless on 2026-11-18 (seed 1001) the goto pilot is then held by Brake 43 m east for the rest of the flight on the ideal vehicle (rubric N1, the target missed) and by Brake, Loiter and RTL on the rig's fitted response (rubric E5): a cell whose label flips with the vehicle, which this family is not.

A constant pilot flies west along the corridor's axis at 3 m/s from 15 m above home (599 m MSL). vz 0 stays level: nothing to repair. vz 1 climbs 1 m/s into the corridor's MSL ceiling (610 m MSL, 27.2 m above the plain): the Shield must hold it under the ceiling. results.why: The SITL MSL profile (experiments/policies/msl_dem_sitl.yaml: msl-ceiling 590-624 m MSL, an altitude_envelope with altitude_ref MSL; agl-band 8-60 m above the ground) over the declared ground experiments/worlds/dem_cmac_wgs84.json. A constant pilot climbs at 1 m/s from 12 m above home while flying 3 m/s east (vy 3: across the ridge, crest 602.75 m MSL at 100 m east, where the AGL floor and the MSL ceiling leave 610.75-624 m MSL) or west (vy -3: over the plain, 582.76 m MSL, where the MSL ceiling binds 41.2 m above the ground, below the AGL ceiling). The Shield must hold the aircraft under 624 m MSL and above the AGL floor. The gates are the requirement: no P0 escape, the flight ended safe. The family exists to fly an MSL altitude_envelope over a varying ground on the sitl / hil rails through the harness (the msl_dem_sitl_0x flights were flown by hand).
